name: onedrive
description: Mirrors a Project between the daemon and each person's own OneDrive in both directions, so files the agent produces appear in their OneDrive without being handed over in chat.

configSchema.label: OneDrive folder
configSchema.hint: Top-level folder created in each person's own OneDrive. Projects and sandbox workspaces are mirrored into separate subfolders of it.

configSchema.label: Sync interval
configSchema.hint: How often a connected mirror is checked, in seconds. Lower values react faster and cost more Microsoft Graph calls.

configSchema.label: Largest file
configSchema.hint: Files above this size are skipped in both directions and reported, rather than silently held back.

configSchema.label: Additional ignored paths
configSchema.hint: Comma-separated glob patterns excluded on top of the project's own .gitignore. Version control internals, dependencies and credentials are always excluded and cannot be re-enabled here.

configSchema.label: Apply deletions from OneDrive
configSchema.hint: When someone deletes a mirrored file in OneDrive, move the local copy into the mirror's own trash folder. The file is never removed outright and can always be recovered.

strings.title: OneDrive
strings.connectHint: Mirror this project into your own OneDrive, in both directions.
strings.notLinked: Your account is not connected to Microsoft.
strings.workspacesHint: Each workspace is mirrored into its own folder, separate from the project itself.
strings.conflictsHint: Both copies were kept. Choose which one wins; nothing is deleted either way.
strings.disconnectHint: Stops mirroring. Files already in OneDrive stay where they are.
strings.mirrorScopeHint: Files excluded by the project's .gitignore are skipped. .git, node_modules, .env, private keys and credential files are never mirrored. You can exclude more paths in the plugin settings, but these protections cannot be turned off.
strings.chooseFolderHint: The folder you choose is the boundary: its files and subfolders are mirrored in both directions, continuously. The rest of the project is not.
strings.noSubfolders: This folder has no subfolders that can be mirrored.
strings.blockedBody: {count} mirrored files disappeared from the project at once, so nothing has been removed from OneDrive yet. If that was intentional, confirm this one sync. Otherwise check that the project folder is complete and sync again.
strings.safetyHint: Nothing is deleted permanently. A file removed in OneDrive is kept in the project under .elowen-trash, and when both sides change the same file, both versions are kept.
